checks.method: Reopened BHL Theorem 1; evaluated its bound exactly and inspected saved primary GitHub directory, commit, README, metadata and Solution responses.

Author/archive listings and returned commit identifiers agree. README and formalization.yaml expressly disclaim registration/endorsement; Solution states support-size bounds. The revised archive-copy wording and attributed formalization status are appropriate; no local build was performed.
checks.scope: Ground-set theorem and corrected PalomarArchive wording

checks.method: Compared browser observation records and root notes with the prospective amendment; independently retrieved the SSRN indexed abstract and attempted both record and PDF URLs.
checks.observation: The native-search record explicitly limits its inspected pages and is a transcribed observation, not a site export. [SSRN6913500](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6913500) names sunflower formulations but its retrieved abstract gives no matching numerical bound; both direct retrieval attempts returned 403. The manuscript preserves this unseen-full-text gap and incomplete native coverage rather than treating either as evidence of absence.

checks.method: Inspected the saved October 25 commit response, freshly fetched that exact commit through the GitHub connector, and compared its fields with the preserved round-5 reconstruction.

The original tree response remains inconsistent as recorded. This relationship neither replays H27 nor links its reviewed source to the historical search.

findings.statement: The fresh H27 commit response identifies the earlier reported root identifier as a commit and the independently reconstructed root identifier as that commit's tree.

revisions.action: Rechecked Section 2's retained qualification and its revised chronological wording against the original addendum and new metadata.
revisions.result: The wording requirement remains resolved. The October 25 comparison is explicitly separate from the October 24 integrity audit; no historical-run authentication or cryptographic completeness of the original returned response is newly claimed.

content.summary: The prospective search update and narrower archive-copy wording are supported within their stated limits. Four concrete checks found no necessary manuscript correction. New commit metadata clarifies the relationship between the H27 identifiers, without authenticating its historical computation or establishing exhaustive priority.
